title: Dedication
text: Thank you to all the crawlers who have helped turn this silly book about a guy and his talking cat into what it is today. Also, I want to extend a special shout-out to the mods on my Discord who have been there since the very beginning. No words can convey how grateful I am that you carry the torch for me. And, Dwight . . . you only have yourself to blame for what happens in this book.
